gloss: to color; to tint; to add color to

definitions.gloss: to color; to tint; to add color to
definitions.explanation: To apply color or pigment to something, giving it a particular hue.

definitions.gloss: to embellish; to add flair to
definitions.explanation: To add interest, beauty, or distinction to something in a figurative sense.

notes:
An ichidan (lower-one-row) transitive verb composed of ⟦{色|いろ}→色：00849_iro⟧ (color) and ⟦{付|つ}ける→付ける：00761_tsukeru⟧ (to attach, to apply). The intransitive counterpart is {色付|いろづ}く (to become colored, to turn color — often said of autumn leaves).

TRANSITIVITY:
- Transitive: {色付|いろづ}ける (to color something)
- Intransitive: {色付|いろづ}く (to become colored)

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {色付|いろづ}ける — to add color
- ⟦{淡|あわ}く→淡い：13293_awai⟧{色付|いろづ}ける — to tint lightly
- ⟦{鮮|あざ}やか→鮮やか：05702_azayaka⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{色付|いろづ}ける — to color vividly

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{着色|ちゃくしょく}→着色：13708_chakushoku⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧ — to color, to dye (more technical/formal)
- ⟦{彩|いろど}る→彩る：12542_irodoru⟧ — to color, to decorate (literary, emphasizes beauty)
